children: According to the [announcement](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/a3ded7ab12f74eaabb4ff384d3216108) from Binance, the platform has launched a new Word of the Day (WOTD) game themed “Keeps AI Agents in Check.” The activity period runs from 2026-09-21 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-09-27 23:59 (UTC). Users who complete five words and reach $50 equivalent trading volume can unlock a share of 10,000 USDC in rewards. Binance described WOTD as an educational word-guessing game designed to help users expand crypto vocabulary and follow market developments. Eligible users may play up to two WOTD games per day during the activity period. Those who answer at least five questions correctly will share a 3,000 USDC reward pool based on their proportion of correct answers among all eligible users. Users who meet the same five-answer threshold and also complete a cumulative $50 equivalent in non-zero fee trades, including Spot, Convert, TradFi, bStocks, or Futures, will share a separate 7,000 USDC pool. Rewards from this second pool will also be distributed according to each user’s proportion of correct answers, with a maximum of 5 USDC per user. All rewards are scheduled to be distributed by 2026-10-11 23:59 (UTC) to the user’s Rewards Hub.

Binance also outlined how users can unlock the second WOTD game after the first round by clicking the “Get A New WOTD” button, sharing the featured link on social media, and having the shared link clicked by a logged-in user. In addition, new users who register for a Binance account using the “WOTD” referral code or the referral link during the activity period will receive 10% off Spot trading fees. These new users may also qualify for additional welcome rewards by completing tasks in the Rewards Hub within 14 days after registration. The announcement said the WOTD game may not be available in certain countries or regions and that only eligible users who complete account verification can participate and receive rewards.

title: Binance Launches Word of the Day Game With 10,000 USDC Rewards
